description: Na₂TiZn₂SiO₇ is Aluminum carbonitride-derived structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbca space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.46 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.67 Å. Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra, corners with seven ZnO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.90-2.08 Å. There are two inequivalent Zn sites. In the first Zn site, Zn is bonded to four O atoms to form ZnO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent TiO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with two equivalent ZnO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 49-63°. There is one shorter (1.94 Å) and three longer (1.95 Å) Zn-O bond lengths. In the second Zn site, Zn is bonded to four O atoms to form ZnO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent TiO₆ octahedra and corners with three equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 57-65°. There are a spread of Zn-O bond distances ranging from 1.92-2.00 Å. Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one TiO₆ octahedra and corners with four ZnO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 54°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.67 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Zn, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Ti and one Zn atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Ti, and one Zn atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Zn, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Zn, and one Si atom to form corner-sharing ONa₂ZnSi tetrahedra. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Ti, one Zn, and one Si atom to form distorted ONaTiZnSi trigonal pyramids that share corners with three equivalent ONa₂ZnSi tetrahedra and  a cornercorner with one ONaTiZn₂ trigonal pyramid. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Ti, and two equivalent Zn atoms to form ONaTiZn₂ trigonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₂ZnSi tetrahedra and corners with three ONaTiZnSi trigonal pyramids.
